2390-3966-5876.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-5876.description:
Gain life.
Elenda's Hierophant triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3293-3899-5282.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
3293-3899-5282.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Wormfang Newt.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1
Repeat.

586-864-3125-4050-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-4050-7396.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

348-1152-4867-5687-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-4867-5687-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Cormela and any creature not part of the combo.
When Cormela dies, it and Skittering Precursor triggers.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

3457-5986-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
3457-5986-7791.description:
Activate Whisperer of the Wilds by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Whisperer of the Wilds.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Whisperer of the Wilds.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7768.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

423-1313-1437-3478.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1313-1437-3478.description:
Cast Arboreal Grazer by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Arboreal Grazer spell three times.
Resolve the first Arboreal Grazer copy.
The Arboreal Grazer token enters the battlefield, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

423-907-1257-1437--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-907-1257-1437--85.description:
Cast Walking Atlas by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Walking Atlas spell three times.
Resolve the first Walking Atlas copy.
Activate the Walking Atlas token by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

3817-4605-5147-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

321-399-2475-5705-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Metallic Sliver trigger, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-3121-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Master enters, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Marionette Master trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1170-1329-2059-2478.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Mishra's Bauble.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Village Bell-Ringer.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1491-4474-6218-6260.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

224-1174-2248.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a mana-producing land.
224-1174-2248.notablePrerequisites: Skyshroud Ranger does not have summoning sickness.
224-1174-2248.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Activate the land and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping another land.
Repeat.

66-2793-6248.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Phenomenon Investigators and Artificer Class trigger.
Resolve the Artificer Class trigger, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Put the token Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and the token's replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat during each of your turns.

2103-2304-3019-4377-5546.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
Capture of Jingzhou and Walk the Aeons exiled by Arcane Bombardment.
2103-2304-3019-4377-5546.description:
Cast Inspiring Refrain by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Arcane Bombardment triggers, exiling a random instant or sorcery from your graveyard, and then casting a copy of Capture of Jingzhou and Walk the Aeons without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the Capture of Jingzhou and Walk the Aeons copies, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain, causing you to draw two cards and exile Inspiring Refrain with three time counters on it.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain.
Move to your first extra turn, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain during your upkeep.
Move to your second extra turn, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain during your upkeep.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

957-1987-4423-4863.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
957-1987-4423-4863.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

575-897-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Branchsnap Lorian.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1115-1232-1270-5477.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

1621-2034-3605-4871-5006.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a card using Lurrus this turn.
1621-2034-3605-4871-5006.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wispweaver Angel, adding {C}{C}.
When Wispweaver Angel dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Dance of the Dead from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it returns Wispweaver Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Repeat.

654-774-5249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three basic snow lands.
654-774-5249.description:
Activate three basic snow lands you control by tapping them, adding {3}.
Activate Icebreaker Kraken by returning the three snow lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Patron of the Moon twice by paying {2}, putting the three snow lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
The snow lands enter the battlefield, triggering Amulet of Vigor three times, untapping the snow lands.
Repeat.

1528-2178-5219-5231.notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature without summoning sickness.
1528-2178-5219-5231.description:
Cast Caberetti Charm by paying {R}{G}{W}.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting and Thornbite Staff attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Cabaretti Charm.
Resolve the copy of Cabaretti Charm, creating two 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Citizen, adding {R}.
The Citizen dies, triggering the creature with Dual Casting and Thornbite Staff attached, untapping the creature.
Repeat from step 2.

938-1582-3263-3771-5231.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
938-1582-3263-3771-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Marang River Prowler, adding {R}.
Cast Marang River Prowler from your graveyard for {1}.
Ominous Roost triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Repeat.

1049-1283-2034-4871.description:
Tap orrery to cast Jirina.
on ETB create one token.
Sacrifice that token and Jirina to Ashnod's Altar, this will make 2 treasure, sacrifice those treasures for 6 mana total.
Repeat getting more tokens and mana each time.

527-2024.manaNeeded: {G}, plus an additional {1} available if you do not control a creature with power 5 or greater
527-2024.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
527-2024.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Selvala and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
